notes: Gravimetric (Rubotherm magnetic suspension balance, buoyancy-corrected) H2 isotherms at 77 K to 8 MPa for C60-HQ clathrate, guest-free beta-HQ, MeOH-HQ, CO2-HQ, alpha-HQ and fullerite (Figure 4a); volumetric g/L values were calculated from lattice parameters. I2: fullerite (pure C60) is plotted in Fig. 4a on the same pressure grid as the authors' samples with no citation, so it is taken as measured here; the C60-HQ clathrate itself, HQ3(C60), is also carbon-majority by formula (about 89 wt% C, C60 about 69 wt%), a carbon-organic hybrid. Li-doped clathrate capacities are GCMC only. No surface area for any sample, so excluded as no_surface_area; no earlier code applies (primary article, not retracted, conditions stated).
